newsitem.title: USA: OXIS Int'l says to list on Paris market.
newsitem.headline: OXIS Int'l says to list on Paris market.

text.p: Oxis International Inc, a Portland, Ore.,-based drug discovery and diagnostics company, said Tuesday it had signed agreements with underwriters for the listing of 10.0 million of its common shares on the Paris Stock Market, Le Nouveau Marche, not later than May 15.
The company said the agreement was signed in Paris and that settlement of the sale of the shares will close not later than May 20.
"We are the first company listed on the Nasdaq to be listed on Le Nouveau Marche, a market set up to finance emerging growth companies in Europe," said Mike DeMello, a company spokesman.
Oxis International operates a French subsidiary, Oxis International S.A., outside Paris, he said.

The company said that proceeds from the sale of the shares will be used to carry out Phase II clinical trials of its lead therapeutic molecule, BXT-51072, a glutathione peroxidase mimic which is a proposed drug for inflammatory bowel diseases.
Proceeds will also be used to initiate preclinical studies in a second lead molecule, TX-153, it said.
